title: IoT Default Credential Scanner — Test Default Passwords on Discovered Devices
goal: Test all discovered LAN devices with HTTP/HTTPS management interfaces against a list of manufacturer-specific default credentials, and flag any that accept them.
scope: Create workers/runners/iot_default_creds/runner.py. Takes the inventory from a previous discovery run (nmap + mdns-ssdp). For each host with an open HTTP/HTTPS port: (1) Detect device type from HTTP banner, Server header, title tag, or mDNS device-type metadata. (2) Look up manufacturer-specific default credentials from a bundled default-creds.json database containing: Unifi (ubnt/ubnt), Philips Hue bridge (no auth by default - finding), Home Assistant (no default auth - check), routers by model, Denon receivers (no auth on web interface - finding), QNAP (admin/admin), Synology (admin/admin), Ubiquiti EdgeRouter (ubnt/ubnt), camera brands (admin/admin, admin/12345, admin/password, root/root, root/12345). (3) Attempt login to the management interface using the found credentials (HTTP Basic Auth or form-based). Use single attempt per credential pair with rate limiting. Stop on first success. (4) For devices with NO authentication required (e.g. Philips Hue bridge, some cameras), create HIGH finding: 'Management interface accessible without authentication'. For devices accepting default credentials, create CRITICAL finding: 'Default manufacturer credentials accepted'. Include: device type, IP, port, credential pair used (redacted in report). Require active authorization level to run this profile. Profile: active-lan-default-creds-audit.
generation_reason: Home routers, IoT devices, cameras, smart home hubs frequently ship with default credentials (admin/admin, ubnt/ubnt) and are never changed. Current AegisPT only tests null-session SMB. Default credential testing on web interfaces is a standard pentest step that is completely absent.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Single credential pair per device type, not full bruteforce. Max 3 attempts per host. Requires active authorization. No credential storage beyond findings.

success_criteria: Default credential database bundled with 50+ manufacturer entries.
Devices without authentication flagged as HIGH findings.
Default credentials accepted flagged as CRITICAL findings.
Credential pair redacted in exported reports.

acceptance_criteria: Default creds tested. No-auth interfaces found. Rate limiting works. Findings created with severity.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
